uniques.title: Hunt your missing uniques
uniques.detail: Every Unique has one dedicated Lair Boss — bring its Lair Key (or Greater Lair Key) and open the Hoard; bosses no longer need summon items. When you're chasing uniques from several bosses, run Belial (Lord of Lies): he mimics any boss's loot table and guarantees an Ancestral Unique. You can also gamble the slot at the Purveyor of Curiosities with Obols, or salvage-and-imprint to fill its aspect.

aspects.title: Fill your Codex of Power
aspects.detail: Salvage spare Legendaries at the Blacksmith — the Codex permanently stores the BEST roll you've ever salvaged, account-wide. Then Imprint from the Codex at the Occultist (unlimited, costs gold + materials). Target-farm aspect carriers with a Tribute of Armaments in the Kurast Undercity, or Obol-gamble the cheapest slot that can hold the aspect.

affixes.title: Chase the missing affixes
affixes.detail: One wrong innate affix is fixable: enchant it at the Occultist (one affix per item, forever — and enchanting can never make or keep a Greater Affix). Two or more wrong = replace the base. Farm fresh bases in Helltides, Nightmare Dungeons, or the Kurast Undercity, or gamble the slot at the Purveyor.

temper.title: Temper at the Blacksmith
temper.detail: Tempering adds ONE affix you choose from a learned manual (only the value rolls). Uniques and Mythics can be tempered now too. You can't brick an item: a Scroll of Restoration refills its temper charges. Learn Legendary Temper Manuals from Tree of Whispers caches (they start dropping at Torment 2).

sockets.title: Socket gems & runes (Jeweler)
sockets.detail: Add a missing socket for 1 Scattered Prism (from Treasure Goblins, World Bosses, Legion events), then craft the gem your build wants — or a runeword (a Ritual + Invocation rune pair) in a 2-socket Helm/Chest/Pants/2H weapon. Gems and runes can't share an item.

masterwork.title: Masterwork to push rolls higher
masterwork.detail: Masterwork at the Blacksmith: each upgrade adds Quality (max 25), giving +1% to every affix; at Quality 25 a Capstone adds +50% to one affix. Farm Obducite in Nightmare Dungeons (Treasure Breach sigils / Strongrooms), the Kurast Undercity (Tribute of Refinement), or Infernal Hordes. Neathiron (to reroll the Capstone) comes from World Bosses and Bartuc / Astaroth / Belial.

glyphs.title: Level your Glyphs
glyphs.detail: Glyphs level ONLY in The Pit — 3 upgrade attempts per clear (+1 if you finish deathless). An attempt is a guaranteed upgrade when the Pit tier is at least your glyph's level + 10. Leveling widens the glyph's radius and, around level 45, can upgrade a Rare glyph to Legendary.

greaterAffixes.title: Hunt Greater Affixes
greaterAffixes.detail: Greater Affix odds rise sharply at Torment 8+. The Tower's 'Treasures of the Artificer' caches give items with GUARANTEED Greater Affixes — the most reliable source. A Greater Tribute of Armaments in the Kurast Undercity drops Ancestral Legendaries.

currency.title: Run Helltides for crafting currency
currency.detail: Helltides are the prime Forgotten Souls source (for enchanting) and drop Lair Keys and XP. Spend Cinders on Tortured Gifts for targeted-slot gear. Obducite and tempering mats also come from Infernal Hordes spoils.

warPlans.title: Set a War Plan (Temis)
warPlans.detail: Queue a playlist of up to 5 of these activities as a War Plan in Temis for stacked bonus rewards (extra keys, Obducite, Obols, runes) on top of each activity's normal loot.

hordesSpoils.name: Spoils of Greater Equipment
hordesSpoils.yields: an Ancestral Legendary plus Obducite, and often 1-2 Scrolls of Restoration

hordesSpoils.name: Spoils of Materials
hordesSpoils.yields: Obducite, Gem Fragments, and Forgotten Souls

hordesSpoils.name: Spoils of Gold
hordesSpoils.yields: a large pile of gold for enchant and Capstone rerolls

hordesSpoils.name: Bartuc, Lord of Chaos
hordesSpoils.yields: Bartuc's unique table plus enhanced gear and Neathiron

universal.name: Belial, Lord of Lies
universal.note: choose any boss's loot table; guarantees an Ancestral Unique and has the best Mythic chance
